notes: Fenrir is now for every game: it opens on Games, lists what your Steam, Epic and GOG libraries own but this PC has not downloaded, and shows what each game is like before you install it.
Mash up to four games at once, picking what each one brings. The builder now plays what it builds, with your yes, and reads the logs to fix what broke.
Sites & apps puts anything on this PC online: a website folder, an app or a port, with a free public address, your own domain or just your home network.
